name: "Stun Lock" (3.0)  -  Captain America / Protection - May '21
description_md: _____ _Trying to update all my decks, without further ado, here's 3.0..._ **UPDATED 3.0: May/2021** Added: - [Honorary Avenger](/card/03025) x1 - [Nick Fury](/card/01084) x1 - [Quincarrier](/card/08023) x1 - [Starhawk](/card/16012) x1 - [Clea](/card/09013) x1 - [Iron Fist](/card/09014) x1 - [Never Back Down](/card/14014) x2 - [Unflappable](/card/09020) x1 - [Electrostatic Armor](/card/10031) x1 Dropped: - Down Time x1 - Expert Defense x2 - Luke Cage x1 - Counter-Punch x2 - Indomitable x1 - Get Behind Me! x2 - Tackle x1 _The new rules with (defense) only benefited Captain America. [Shield Block](/card/03005) just got stronger and open up combos with new cards like [Never Back Down](/card/14014), [Electrostatic Armor](/card/10031), and [Unflappable](/card/09020). Green also got some much needed low-cost allies. And now even more ways to stun with [Never Back Down](/card/14014) & [Iron Fist](/card/09014)._ _____ **Overview** - Captain America is (STILL) one of the best heroes right now in the current meta, probably without a doubt in solo games. Due to the nature of stun in a solo game, you are basically able to shut down the villain's entire activation in a turn. - The Stun Lock takes that idea to the next level with [Tackle](/card/05015), [Never Back Down](/card/14014), and [Iron Fist](/card/09014), allowing you to always have a stun on hand and lock out the villain from ever attacking. - A few of his basic cards, like [Super-Soldier Serum](/card/03010), [Heroic Strike](/card/03004), [Shield Block](/card/03005), and [Fearless Determination](/card/03003) are (STILL) some of the best in the game. _____ **Strategy:** *Mulligan* - Remember that your alter ego setup initiates after you draw/mulligan. So if you draw your shield, dump it and you'll get it back. As usual you want to get your engine going so any resource cards or those that allow you to draw cards or are resources are keepers. - You could also consider keeping 1 ally in hand for Steve Rogers's "Living Legend" ability. - Generally, you are searching for Captain America's: [Super-Soldier Serum](/card/03010) and [Steve's Apartment](/card/03007), then depending on your most urgent need whether that is defending or thwarting ([Shield Block](/card/03005) and [Fearless Determination](/card/03003) , respectively). *Stun* - Essentially as the name of the deck says, you're stunning every turn with [Tackle](/card/05015), [Heroic Strike](/card/03004), [Never Back Down](/card/14014), [Iron Fist](/card/09014) or [Mockingbird](/card/01083). I've had games where I've stunned the villain every turn and never took damage. Stun as much as possible while building up your board and flip to Steve Rogers and heal when you get threat to low level and have an ally in hand. - You also want to make sure you get at least one [Super-Soldier Serum](/card/03010) down early so you can ensure having a for [Tackle](/card/05015) and [Heroic Strike](/card/03004). However, if you're in a pinch, don't be afraid to use a Tackle or Never Back Down to get that resource -- you have x2 in the deck along with x3 [Heroic Strike](/card/03004). Of course [Quincarrier](/card/08023) now helps with this too. *Defense* - With [Captain America's Shield](/card/03009) and [Armored Vest](/card/01081) you'll be defending for 4 which can essentially mitigate most attacks. If the villain has extra boost cards or you're expecting a harder hit you have [Shield Block](/card/03005). - [Shield Block](/card/03005) just got stronger and open up combos with [Never Back Down](/card/14014), [Electrostatic Armor](/card/10031), and [Unflappable](/card/09020). - Put down [Indomitable](/card/01082) when you're able, but "I can do this all day!" allows you to untap on your turn. - Captain America essentially 'retaliates' for 2 with [Electrostatic Armor](/card/10031). *Encounter Cards* - If Captain America has a weakness, it's controlling the encounter phase. Against more difficult villains you'll have a bit tougher time dealing with unanticipated schemes and multiple attacks from Treachery cards. That's where [Black Widow](/card/01075) comes in. Get her on the board early and pair her with your [Honorary Avenger](/card/03025) -- it's meant for her. - Once you have [Black Widow](/card/01075) paired with an [Honorary Avenger](/card/03025), you can now use your [Med Team](/card/01080) to use her for THW. You'll also use [Quincarrier](/card/08023) for her ability if needed. - After one swing of thwart with [Black Widow](/card/01075) you'll just keep her on the board solely for her ability. A reminder that you will be able to use Black Widow when you are on Alter-Ego side. _____ **Other Card Considerations:** - As I outlined above, I changed a lot of cards for 3.0. The following cards could be used for your playstyle: 1. [Counter-Punch](/card/01077) - Works well with the new defense rules. 2. [Dauntless](/card/16016) - Retaliate for 3!!! 3. [Nerves of Steel](/card/14017) - I found it wasn't really worth it for me. 4. [Tenacity](/card/01093) - With a resource always at hand, could be useful if you absolutely have to retap twice, especially with [Fearless Determination](/card/03003) buff. 5. [Brother Voodoo](/card/09012) - You have some very good event cards! ______ _Hope you have fun with this build, any feedback is welcome.
